Description.header: Allocates an ephemeral FIFO and uploads a file into this container.
Description.body: Write the request arguments to exec, read the returned input FIFO path, stream the file to that FIFO, and read async_result in the same request directory. metadata may be empty or a JSON object. destination is an existing container directory. preferred_filename may be empty to generate an uploaded.<UTC timestamp> name automatically.
Description.footer: The three timeout parameters bound initial upload silence, silence between upload chunks, and final result retention.
